content.text: This is the bottom strip of a 3840x2088 landscape Jin Chan Chan (TFT) game frame, with a red measurement grid: vertical lines every 50 NATIVE px (native x labels printed along the BOTTOM edge of the image, values like 192, 242, 292 ...), horizontal lines every 50 native px. The strip shows the 9-slot bench row (9 large champion cards on pedestals, upper part of the image; some slots may be empty) and below it small shop cards (ignore them). Task: locate the 8 VERTICAL DIVIDER SEAMS between the 9 bench slot cells (the thin dark vertical lines that separate adjacent bench cells; do NOT use card borders, champion art, or pedestal rims - look for the narrow dark gaps BETWEEN neighboring cells). Report the native x of each of the 8 dividers, left to right (d1..d8), reading the grid labels and interpolating to the nearest 10 px. Also report bench_left (native x where the bench row begins, left edge of slot 0) and bench_right (native x where it ends, right edge of slot 8). If some dividers are not visible (e.g. slot empty), estimate them from the visible ones and lower conf. Output ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no prose: {"dividers":[<x1>,<x2>,...,<x8>],"bench_left":<x>,"bench_right":<x>,"conf":<0-1>}.
